citation_problems.citation: [[rts392-issuer-investor-csd]] — 'The bundle's excerpt also stops mid-way at point (g), so any definition after (f) is not in reviewed evidence' (section 1) and 'the bundle's capture stops mid-point (g)' (Open items 2)
citation_problems.problem: Minor mis-description of the excerpt's extent, not penalised: point (g) 'durable medium' is captured in full, so the excerpt ends at (g) rather than mid-way through it, and (g) itself is in reviewed evidence. The imprecision concerns a definition irrelevant to the question and errs toward under-claiming coverage; every quoted definition, locator and review date is otherwise exact.
citation_problems.passage_quote: (g) 'durable medium' means any instrument which enables the storage of information in a way that is accessible for future reference for a period of time adequate for the purposes of the information, and allows the unchanged reproduction of the information stored.

unsupported_claims: Minor, not penalised: source pointers in the Unresolved requirement and Open items — an 'eligible-instruments list' and the 'Euronext Securities Milan public documentation hub' — appear in no passage; they name where to look rather than assert any operational rule. The 'notary / central maintenance' wording is correctly labelled 'Explanation, not a documented requirement' with the note that the bundle does not print Section A points 1–2.
reason: The decisive passages are RTS 2017/392 Article 1(e) 'a CSD which provides the core service referred to in point 1 or 2 of Section A of the Annex to Regulation (EU) No 909/2014 in relation to a securities issue' and (f) 'a CSD that either is a participant in the securities settlement system operated by another CSD ... in relation to a securities issue', both quoted verbatim, together with [[t2s-realignment]] PDF 375 'Or both, when it is the CSD in which the security has been issued and the CSD of at least one party of the Settlement Instruction' and the bundle LIMITATION 'Roles depend on the security and relationship: one CSD can be issuer CSD for one issue and investor CSD for another', which the answer uses to show the roles are relational and that one CSD can hold both. The omnibus-account / technical-issuer mechanics (PDF 375–376), Milan Article 77 (PDF 54, Italian text prevails), all LIMITATION lines, the R2026.JUN and R2026.NOV release identities (November publication explicitly not treated as deployment) and the review dates are carried accurately; no fixed institutional label is asserted and no specific ISIN chain is claimed, with per-ISIN attribution correctly marked as not in reviewed evidence. The only blemish is the immaterial statement that the RTS excerpt stops mid-way through point (g), whereas (g) is captured in full.
